verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ אֹודֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָ֑ב בְּסֹ֖וד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה׃
verses.ar: هَلِّلُويَا. أَحْمَدُ ٱلرَّبَّ بِكُلِّ قَلْبِي فِي مَجْلِسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ وَجَمَاعَتِهِمْ.
verses.en: Hallelujah. I will give thanks unto the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with [my] whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and [in] the congregation.
verses.web: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.ar: عَظِيمَةٌ هِيَ أَعْمَالُ ٱلرَّبِّ. مَطْلُوبَةٌ لِكُلِّ ٱلْمَسْرُورِينَ بِهَا.
verses.en: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have delight therein.
verses.kjv: The works of the LORD [are] great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.web: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

verses.ar: جَلَالٌ وَبَهَاءٌ عَمَلُهُ، وَعَدْلُهُ قَائِمٌ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: His work is glory and majesty; and His righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.kjv: His work [is] honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.web: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

verses.he: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: صَنَعَ ذِكْرًا لِعَجَائِبِهِ. حَنَّانٌ وَرَحِيمٌ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.en: He hath made a memorial for His wonderful works; the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.kjv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD [is] gracious and full of compassion.
verses.web: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

verses.he: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעֹולָ֣ם בְּרִיתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: أَعْطَى خَائِفِيهِ طَعَامًا. يَذْكُرُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ عَهْدَهُ.
verses.en: He hath given food unto them that fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.
verses.kjv: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.web: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

verses.he: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמֹּ֑ו לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גֹּויִֽם׃
verses.ar: أَخْبَرَ شَعْبَهُ بِقُوَّةِ أَعْمَالِهِ، لِيُعْطِيَهُمْ مِيرَاثَ ٱلْأُمَمِ.
verses.en: He hath declared to His people the power of His works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
verses.kjv: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.web: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

verses.he: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃
verses.ar: أَعْمَالُ يَدَيْهِ أَمَانَةٌ وَحَقٌّ. كُلُّ وَصَايَاهُ أَمِينَةٌ.
verses.en: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are sure.
verses.kjv: The works of his hands [are] verity and judgment; all his commandments [are] sure.
verses.web: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

verses.he: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעֹולָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר׃
verses.ar: ثَابِتَةٌ مَدَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ، مَصْنُوعَةٌ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ.
verses.en: They are established for ever and ever, they are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.kjv: They stand fast for ever and ever, [and are] done in truth and uprightness.
verses.web: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.he: פְּד֤וּת ׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמֹּ֗ו צִוָּֽה־לְעֹולָ֥ם בְּרִיתֹ֑ו קָדֹ֖ושׁ וְנֹורָ֣א שְׁמֹֽו׃
verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ فِدَاءً لِشَعْبِهِ. أَقَامَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ عَهْدَهُ. قُدُّوسٌ وَمَهُوبٌ ٱسْمُهُ.
verses.en: He hath sent redemption unto His people; He hath commanded His covenant for ever; Holy and awful is His name.
verses.kjv: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend [is] his name.
verses.web: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

verses.he: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חָכְמָ֨ה ׀ יִרְאַ֬ת יְהוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל טֹ֖וב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּתֹ֗ו עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.ar: رَأْسُ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ مَخَافَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ. فِطْنَةٌ جَيِّدَةٌ لِكُلِّ عَامِلِيهَا. تَسْبِيحُهُ قَائِمٌ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; a good understanding have all they that do thereafter; His praise endureth for ever.
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do [his commandments:] his praise endureth for ever.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
